name: terrarium
description: A tiny one-level orchestration harness for composable subagents.

scripts.demo: node src/cli.js "write a haiku about delegated context" --dry-run
scripts.probe:all: node src/cli.js probe filesystem-write-outside-workspace --json && node src/cli.js probe environment-canary --json && node src/cli.js probe network-disabled --json && node src/cli.js probe filesystem-read-canary --json && node src/cli.js probe process-persistence --json
scripts.attack:dry: node src/cli.js attack environment-canary --agent "node -e \"console.log('TERRARIUM_ATTACK_RESULT={' + String.fromCharCode(34) + 'run' + String.fromCharCode(34) + ':true,' + String.fromCharCode(34) + 'reason' + String.fromCharCode(34) + ':' + String.fromCharCode(34) + 'bounded-detector' + String.fromCharCode(34) + '}')\"" --json

author: Jordan Coeyman
